title: Lake Bled & Slovenia
introTitle: From Budapest to the Slovenian Alps.
intro: The day begins in Budapest with a visit to the Hungary branch office before heading west toward Slovenia. Late in the afternoon, the route reaches Lake Bled for one of the first major Alpine views of the trip before continuing to Kamnik for the night.

stops.name: Hungary Bethel
stops.description: Visit the Hungary Bethel Branch Office in Budapest.

stops.name: Lake Bled
stops.description: A late-afternoon stop at Lake Bled for views of the lake, island and surrounding Julian Alps.

stops.name: Kamnik
stops.description: Continue to Kamnik for the overnight stay.
